proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb hab
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt ha
  have ht := Real.sq_sqrt hb
  have hab' : a - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  have hprod : (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) * (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) = a - b := by
    linear_combination hs - ht
  have hsum : Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hprod
    exact hab' hprod.symm
  have hdiff : Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero] at hprod
    exact hab' hprod.symm
  constructor
  · rw [div_eq_div_iff hsum hab']
    linear_combination -hprod
  · rw [div_eq_div_iff hdiff hab']
    linear_combination -hprod
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a ≠ b → 1 / (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) = (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) / (a - b) ∧ 1 / (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) = (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) / (a - b)
